name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  security-scan:
    name: Scan for security issues
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd  # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run security scanner
        run: |
          python3 scripts/scan_plugin.py plugins

yaml:
name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  security-scan:
    name: Scan for security issues
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd  # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run security scanner
        run: |
          python3 scripts/scan_plugin.py plugins
